title: Velocita — Paper trading
description: Active cluster: stochastic paper only. Paper trading: the gateway against the fill-or-kill simulator. The session's account, gateway stages, orders, fills, position and fees. No real order is sent.

panels.title: Active stochastic paper cluster: gateway status
New risk
panels.description: 1 = the gateway sends no risk-increasing order. After an election it re-arms by itself once the cluster is quiet and the venue reconciles; after an unknown outcome, a conflict, a control change or a reconciliation mismatch only a restart (after checking the gateway journal) re-arms it. Alert: VelocitaGatewayNewRiskStopped. An armed gateway alone does not imply an active strategy; check session status and submitter.

panels.title: Stochastic one-second session — isolated $25 virtual account
Stochastic one-second session: rules and assumptions

options.content:
**Ongoing paper session: one-second completed bars; SOL/cash; 0.12 SOL orders.**

```text
ENTER: K crosses above D, K >= 60, EMA300 > EMA1200;
       all conditions hold for 3 seconds.
EXIT:  K < D and K <= 40 for 3 seconds.
Wait 60 seconds after an exit before re-entry.
STOP:  while flat, cash cannot cover 0.12 SOL plus its fee.
```

Stochastic range 900 seconds; K smoothing 10 seconds; D smoothing 30 seconds.
Signals use the previous completed second. Public Binance SOLUSDT is a price
proxy; simulated FOK fills use the following close. **20 bp per side, fee-only**;
buy-side symmetry is assumed. This is not proof of True Markets execution or alpha.

**No scheduled time cutoff.** Continues from **$24.869170**, preserving the
original $25 funding and all four prior fills. Session-only metrics exclude
those prior fills; lifetime and 7/14-day panels include them. One cluster only.
The $10 drawdown, 240 lifetime-order, reconciliation and storage guards remain.
While invested in SOL, low USDC does not block selling. A finalized flat session
keeps its balances and fills visible even after the edge stops.

panels.title: Session status
panels.description: Completed requires flat inventory and a checked final ledger. Running window alone is not a health assertion.

Net P&L since funding (account history; new fills 20 bp)
panels.description: Account lifetime includes old 30 bp fills and new 20 bp fee-only fills. Session-only panels isolate the new rules; buy-side 20 bp remains assumed.

panels.title: Age of last recorded candle
panels.description: Naturally increases once the session is completed. No fresh price is needed to value a flat final account.

panels.title: P&L under historical 100/98 bp stress
panels.description: Historical route stress case: same fills re-priced at the September 28 100/98 bp quotes; not the current 20 bp CLI service fee.

panels.title: Volume per $1 lost (account history; new fills 20 bp)
panels.description: Total buy and sell volume divided by the loss so far, as simulated. Empty while the account is not at a loss.

panels.title: Volume per $1 lost (100/98 bp stress)
panels.description: Historical route stress case: same fills re-priced at the September 28 100/98 bp quotes; not the current 20 bp CLI service fee. Plain churn achieves about $101 on SOL.

panels.title: Drawdown stop used
panels.description: Share of the $10 drawdown that stops new buys and requests an exit.

panels.title: Bar close to fill (mean)
panels.description: No exact signal-to-fill join is currently instrumented for this one-second session. The configured delay is one completed bar; do not infer a measurement from fill timestamps.

panels.title: Bar close to fill (max)
panels.description: No exact signal-to-fill join is currently instrumented for this one-second session. The configured delay is one completed bar; do not infer a measurement from fill timestamps.

panels.title: SOL price with confirmed entries / exits
panels.description: Markers are confirmed simulated fills, never raw signals. Their chart time has scrape/bucket resolution; exact confirmation times are retained in the ledger. Missed historical times are unknown, not invented. Zoom in to inspect close entries/exits.

panels.title: Decision samples (range estimate)
panels.description: Prometheus increase extrapolates between scrapes and handles process counter resets; this is an estimated count, not an exact event ledger.

panels.title: Mean tick to decision
panels.description: Payload delivered to Python through receipt of the committed decision at the local C++ submitter. Includes indicators, durable journal and two Raft commits. Excludes HTTP fetch, authorization and fills. Same-host wall clock; clock steps can distort durations.

panels.title: p99 estimate (100+ samples)
panels.description: Bucket interpolation, not an exact observed percentile. Hidden below an estimated 100 samples. Five-minute decisions do not characterize high-load tail latency.

panels.title: Tick to decision: mean by component (30m)
panels.description: edge: feature/journal work and IPC; source_commit and decision_commit: request to committed reply, including networking, scheduling, quorum and durable storage. Not pure kernel execution time.

panels.title: Buy stops
panels.description: Stops are independent for each account. Loss/capacity/duration stops persist across restart.

panels.title: Venue vs kernel
panels.description: 1 = at a comparable cut the paper venue's base differed from the kernel's position (zero-lot tolerance). New risk stays stopped until a restart. Alert: VelocitaGatewayReconciliationMismatch.

panels.title: Compared position (lots)
panels.description: Kernel and venue position at the last comparable cut; frozen at the values of a mismatch.

panels.title: Re-arms (range)
panels.description: Automatic re-arms after a fence (election or state-read gap).

panels.title: Since clean reconciliation
panels.description: Seconds since the venue's book last matched the kernel at a comparable cut. 'unknown' = none since the gateway started (a cut is comparable only with no order open).

panels.title: Stops by cause (per hour)
panels.description: fence re-arms by itself after the quiet period; every other cause holds new risk until the gateway is restarted (runbook 5.3).

panels.title: Why new risk is stopped now
panels.description: 1 per active cause. awaiting_arm = only the arming check is pending (quiet period, an open order, or a cut not yet comparable). Alert: VelocitaGatewayAwaitingRearm after 10 m.

panels.title: Stochastic gateway: observed effect -> proof -> send -> fill -> committed
Sum of gateway stage means
panels.description: Four gateway-clock stage means. Starts when the gateway first observes a deliverable effect. Excludes tick processing, decision authorization and the wait before gateway observation. Stages may have different sample counts across a window or restart; this sum is not a paired end-to-end latency.

panels.title: Where the time goes (mean ms per order, 5m)
panels.description: Independent gateway-stage means. Their sum is not full tick-to-trade latency. sent_to_fill is the simulated venue.

panels.title: p99 by stage (selected range, 100+ orders)
panels.description: 99th percentile of each stage over the dashboard's time range, from the stage histogram. Shown only for a stage with at least 100 orders in the range. Percentiles do not add.

panels.title: Orders per stage (selected range)
panels.description: How many orders each stage timing is based on. Below 100 the percentile panels stay empty.

panels.title: Stage latency p50 (selected range, 100+ orders)
panels.description: Median per stage. Resolution is limited by the histogram's buckets.

panels.title: Stage latency p99 (selected range, 100+ orders)
panels.description: 99th percentile per stage, from bucket interpolation.

panels.title: Rejects (range)
panels.description: Orders the (simulated) venue or the gateway refused.

panels.title: Authority requests (range)
panels.description: Requests the gateway made to the cluster for authority to send.

panels.title: Orders and fills per minute
panels.description: Orders the gateway sent to the venue, and fills it received, by side.

panels.title: Rejects by reason (per minute)
panels.description: Why orders were refused.

panels.title: Authority requests by result (per minute)
panels.description: The cluster's answers to the gateway's requests for authority.

panels.title: Unknown outcomes (per 5 minutes)
panels.description: Any value above 0 stopped new risk (alert: VelocitaGatewayUnknownOutcome).

panels.title: Position (lots)
panels.description: The gateway's paper position per account and instrument, in lots.

panels.title: Position over time (lots)
